clips.title: The story
paras: A Hardened Tumor is a rare biological anomaly harvested from the Vile Fin murlocs dwelling around Lake Lordamere. Noted originally in the research of Apothecary Berard, now a mindless servant of Arugal, this calcified growth serves as an unusual reagent in the Royal Apothecary Society's efforts to brew the New Plague.

While studying the indigenous wildlife along the eastern borders of Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Berard cataloged an abnormal, calcified growth developing within the Vile Fin murlocs of Lake Lordamere. Such growths are exceedingly rare, appearing only in mature specimens along the shoreline and the Dawning Isles. What causes the Vile Fin murlocs to produce these hardened masses remains uncertain, but their dense, morbid tissue caught the immediate attention of the Royal Apothecary Society.
